summary:
A jury in Miami has decided that Tesla must pay more than $240 million to victims in a case involving its Autopilot system. The lawsuit followed a crash, and the people who brought the case are described as victims in Miami. The exact number of victims and the details of the crash are not included in the available article text.

The key figure is the award of more than $240 million. Tesla is the company that must pay this amount. The article does not say what happens next, such as whether Tesla plans to appeal the decision or how the money will be divided among the victims. No further information about the legal arguments or the crash is provided.
